title: Apollo lunar dust in Charles's lab and lunar retroreflectors
summary: Charles tells of Apollo lunar dust in Charles's lab and lunar retroreflectors, about 1969-1972; recent Firefly reflector at The Moon, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I have a 200 gram or so in my lab.

plain: A NASA scientist named Charles tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he keeps about 200 grams of Moon dust in his lab, brought back by the Apollo missions that landed astronauts on the Moon between 1969 and 1972. He also talks about retroreflectors, mirrors left on the Moon's surface that bounce lasers back to Earth, including a recent one carried by a newer lander.
